ai_analysis.summary: This is a sponsored promotional post for data science interview preparation, headed with a Data Scientist role at Amazon and a stated CTC of Rs 36+ LPA. It presents 15 SQL interview questions, labeled as ranging from intermediate to hard, covering HAVING versus WHERE, Auto Increment, set operators, nth-record retrieval, uniqueness without DISTINCT, even and odd record selection, clustered and non-clustered indexes, recursive CTEs, RANK versus DENSE_RANK, correlated queries, MAGIC TABLES, extracting the first five characters of a string, conditional aggregation, and an employee department and highest-salary query. The post supplies no answers or technical explanations. It then promotes Bosscoder Academy, stating that it has helped more than 2,200 working professionals switch to top data science roles and listing structured curriculum, professional mentorship, business case studies, placement support, and a limited-time 25% Independence Day sale.
